sourceClass: fixed-V5 call-chain audit + explicit Web owner-domain adaptation
sectionHashRule: Inclusive original byte lines, preserving CR/LF and final newline.

sections.meaning: DamageEffect frame manager iterates live effects and calls each effect; no local-owner gate.
CEffect frame path: stop/live-mesh guards and direct call to OnFrameMove_LockOnData; no local-owner gate enclosing that call.
Lock-on entry has game, mesh and delayed-unlock guards, not an owner-authority guard.
LOT6 branch chooses and retargets through X2Game; no local-only branch or synchronized-target packet path in this branch.
Nearest target uses the X2Game-global previous-target set; exclusion-enabled failed search clears it and successful search inserts the UID.

sourceFindings.historyScope: Client-local X2Game, shared across its effects and owners.
sourceFindings.ownerGate: No local-owner gate was found in the audited frame/LOT6/nearest-target call chain.
sourceFindings.syncEvidence: No synchronized target/history packet consumer was identified in the audited call chain. This is not a claim about every uninspected source file.
sourceFindings.historyLifetime: Search failure clears, search success inserts; this audited selection path does not clear on cast end or actor death.

webAdaptation.offline: All actors use state.sourceBlazeWingPreviousTargets and state.sourceBlazeWingSelectionSerial.
webAdaptation.onlineLocal: The local networkOwnerId uses those same client-local globals.
webAdaptation.onlineRemote: Each remote owner uses state.sourceBlazeWingMirrors[ownerId]={history,serial}, isolated from the local domain and every other remote owner.
webAdaptation.receipt: Only full endMissing reports for a known remote owner, current epoch when supplied by the host, and a strictly newer (epoch,frameSeq) watermark can restore mirror history.
webAdaptation.packetSelection: Maximum sourceBlazeWingLockOn.selectionSerial among matching Blaze Wing effects selects that report history. Equal serials must agree. A later authoritative frame may lower a predicted mirror serial.
webAdaptation.absence: A full report without a live history advances the receipt watermark and retains the previous mirror; absence never means an empty set.
webAdaptation.rollback: state.localBlazeWingHistoryReceipts stores per-owner epoch/frameSeq with snapshot-restored mirrors. No WeakMap(sim) watermark survives an older state restore.
webAdaptation.historicalActions: Partial endMissing:false reports do not write receipt or mirror. Zero-time effect evaluation must return before movement or selection in the caller.
webAdaptation.wire: No new player-supplied top-level fields. Existing per-effect historySnapshot and selectionSerial are validated by the ownership protocol; local mirrors and receipt tables are not owned actor/effect payload.

limits: This isolates Web owner prediction; it is not a native authority gate or a reconstruction of original networking.
Client-local serials do not define a global order across different browser owners.
Per-effect snapshots can be absent after all carriers expire; the last received mirror is then retained, not asserted to be a complete source-global history.
Reference contains later reconstructed source code. Target2016 declarations and this fixed reference are separate evidence; original client networking and trajectory remain unmeasured.
